papers.title: Rare genetic variants influence participation in cognitive components of the UK Biobank
papers.translated_title: 罕见遗传变异影响英国生物银行认知组成部分的参与
papers.author: Fenner, E.
papers.summary: Population-level biobanks are transforming health and genomic research however they are all subject to recruitment and participation biases, the impacts of which are not fully understood. The UK Biobank (UKBB) is one such cohort; it is widely used for health-related research, but its participants are not representative of the UK general population. In addition, those who complete optional components of UKBB differ from those who do not in terms of health-related exposures and outcomes. Participation in UKBB has a partly genetic basis, but the extent to which rare variants influence participation in optional study components, and how this might impact findings of rare variant association studies, is unknown. We analysed exome sequencing and array data from 398,149 UKBB participants to examine rare variant contributions to UKBB participation bias, focusing on cognitive phenotypes. We found that classes of rare variation previously shown to contribute to cognition were enriched among participants who completed fewer cognitive tests. We then compared the effects of rare variants on cognition itself between groups of participants defined by whether they completed all online cognitive tests. Rare variants had significantly weaker effects on cognition in individuals who completed all online cognitive tests than in those who did not. These findings demonstrate that participation is a non-random phenotype that is influenced by rare variants, and that individuals who engage in optional UKBB components are not representative of the broader cohort. We show how participation bias can reduce the power of rare variant association studies, potentially masking true associations. This bias should therefore be carefully considered when interpreting results derived from phenotypes with substantial missingness.
papers.translated_summary: 群体级生物样本库正在改变健康与基因组研究，但它们都受到招募和参与偏倚的影响，而这些偏倚的影响尚未被完全理解。英国生物样本库（UK Biobank，UKBB）就是这样一个队列；它被广泛用于健康相关研究，但其参与者并不能代表英国普通人群。此外，完成 UKBB 可选部分的人在健康相关暴露和结局方面与未完成者不同。参与 UKBB 具有部分遗传基础，但罕见变异在多大程度上影响对可选研究部分的参与，以及这可能如何影响罕见变异关联研究的结果，尚不清楚。我们分析了 398,149 名 UKBB 参与者的外显子组测序和芯片数据，以考察罕见变异对 UKBB 参与偏倚的贡献，重点关注认知表型。我们发现，先前被证明与认知有关的几类罕见变异在完成较少认知测试的参与者中富集。随后，我们根据参与者是否完成了所有在线认知测试进行分组，比较了罕见变异对认知本身的影响。在完成所有在线认知测试的个体中，罕见变异对认知的影响显著弱于未完成者。这些发现表明，参与是一种非随机表型，受到罕见变异影响，并且参与 UKBB 可选部分的个体不能代表更广泛的队列。我们展示了参与偏倚如何降低罕见变异关联研究的效力，可能掩盖真实关联。因此，在解释来自具有大量缺失的表型的结果时，应仔细考虑这种偏倚。

papers.title: Worldwide diversity and geographic structure of killer-cell immunoglobulin-like receptor (KIR) gene content
papers.translated_title: 全球杀伤细胞免疫球蛋白样受体（KIR）基因含量的多样性与地理结构
papers.author: Obeso Fernandez, A.
papers.summary: Introduction: Killer-cell immunoglobulin-like receptor (KIR) gene content shapes natural killer-cell responses and varies substantially among populations. We examined whether worldwide KIR diversity reflects regional structure, isolation by distance, serial founder effects, or latitudinal gradients. Data and methods: Carrier frequencies for 11 variable KIR genes were obtained from the Allele Frequency Net Database. The primary analysis included 189 locally sampled, non-diaspora, non-mixed populations from 70 countries, comprising 25,469 individuals; 161 populations had complete 11-gene profiles. Diversity indices, ordination, clustering, permutation-based variance decomposition, Mantel tests, and regression models were used to characterize geographic structure. Serial founder effects were evaluated using four distance measures from East Africa, both globally and within the Old World. Models of latitude incorporated spatial autocorrelation. Prespecified sensitivity analyses evaluated alternative population sets, gene panels, geographic classifications, weighting schemes, and multivariate outlier exclusion. Results: Geographic region explained 53.5% of variation in KIR profiles, substantially exceeding the permutation-null expectation of 6.9%, although multivariate dispersion differed among regions. Twenty-five of 28 pairwise regional comparisons remained significant after false-discovery-rate correction. Isolation by distance was modest (Mantel r=0.3003) and weakened after controlling for region (r=0.1557). KIR diversity did not decline with distance from East Africa globally but decreased strongly within the Old World (expected heterozygosity {beta}=-0.0066 and standardized gene content {beta}=-0.0789). B-content decreased nominally with absolute latitude, but latitude was collinear with region and the association survived neither spatial modelling nor sensitivity analyses. Regional differentiation remained robust across analytical specifications, whereas the Old World decline was carried by gene content once standard errors were clustered by country. Conclusion: Worldwide KIR gene-content variation shows pronounced regional differentiation, modest isolation by distance, and no independent latitudinal gradient. Diversity declines with distance from East Africa across the Old World, supporting serial founder effects, but not once the Americas and Oceania are included.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：杀伤细胞免疫球蛋白样受体（KIR）基因内容塑造自然杀伤细胞反应，并在人群间存在显著差异。我们检验了全球KIR多样性是否反映区域结构、距离隔离、系列奠基者效应或纬度梯度。数据与方法：从等位基因频率网络数据库获取11个可变KIR基因的携带频率。主要分析纳入来自70个国家的189个本地采样、非侨民、非混合人群，共25，469名个体；161个人群具有完整的11基因谱。采用多样性指数、排序、聚类、基于置换的方差分解、Mantel检验和回归模型来刻画地理结构。使用来自东非的四种距离度量，在全球范围内和旧世界内部评估系列奠基者效应。纬度模型纳入空间自相关。预设的敏感性分析评估了替代人群集、基因组合、地理分类、加权方案和多变量离群值排除。结果：地理区域解释了KIR谱变异的53.5%，大幅超过置换零假设预期的6.9%，尽管多变量离散度在区域间存在差异。在错误发现率校正后，28个区域两两比较中有25个仍显著。距离隔离程度中等（Mantel r=0.3003），在控制区域后减弱（r=0.1557）。KIR多样性在全球范围内未随距东非距离增加而下降，但在旧世界内部强烈下降（期望杂合度{beta}=-0.0066，标准化基因内容{beta}=-0.0789）。B内容名义上随绝对纬度增加而下降，但纬度与区域共线，该关联在空间建模和敏感性分析中均未存活。区域分化在所有分析设定下均保持稳健，而旧世界内部的下降在标准误按国家聚类后由基因内容承载。结论：全球KIR基因内容变异显示出显著的区域分化、中等的距离隔离，且无独立的纬度梯度。多样性在旧世界范围内随距东非距离增加而下降，支持系列奠基者效应，但一旦纳入美洲和大洋洲则不再支持。

papers.title: Costs of influenza-associated healthcare: an umbrella review and meta-regression analysis
papers.translated_title: 流感相关医疗保健的费用：一项伞状综述与元回归分析
papers.author: Goodfellow, L.
papers.summary: Abstract Background Estimates of the healthcare costs associated with influenza treatment are essential for cost-effectiveness analyses that inform preventative and treatment strategies such as vaccination and non-pharmaceutical interventions. Existing evidence varies across treatment settings, age groups, and countries and there is little data from low- and middle-income settings. Methods We conducted an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses reporting direct admitted and non-admitted hospitalisation costs of seasonal influenza treatment in children, adults, and older people. We supplemented an evidence gap with a systematised review of studies reporting adult non-admitted treatment costs. Costs were extracted and adjusted to 2023 USD. We fitted a Bayesian mixed-effects model to estimate influenza treatment costs using national economic indicators, age group, and treatment setting as a priori predictors. We predicted admitted and non-admitted treatment costs for children, adults, and older people in 195 countries and territories. Results Seven reviews were included in the umbrella review, supplemented by 17 primary studies for adult non-admitted care. Extracted data points most frequently described admitted treatment costs and came from high-income countries. The best-fitting model used healthcare expenditure per capita to predict treatment costs, with country-level random effects. Estimated costs increased with healthcare expenditure per capita, were higher for admitted than non-admitted care, and were highest for adults and lowest for children. Conclusions This study provides novel estimates of influenza-associated healthcare costs across age groups and treatment settings by synthesising the available global evidence. By extrapolating to settings without data, our estimates can inform future economic evaluation studies of influenza interventions worldwide.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景 与流感治疗相关的医疗成本估算对于成本效果分析至关重要，这些分析可为疫苗接种和非药物干预等预防和治疗策略提供依据。现有证据因治疗场所、年龄组和国家而异，且来自中低收入环境的数据很少。 方法 我们对报告儿童、成人和老年人季节性流感治疗直接住院和非住院医院成本的系统综述和荟萃分析进行了伞形综述。我们通过一项系统化综述补充了成人非住院治疗成本研究报告的证据缺口。提取成本并调整为2023年美元。我们拟合了一个贝叶斯混合效应模型，使用国家经济指标、年龄组和治疗场所作为先验预测因子来估算流感治疗成本。我们预测了195个国家和地区儿童、成人和老年人的住院和非住院治疗成本。 结果 伞形综述纳入了7篇综述，并由17项关于成人非住院治疗的原始研究补充。提取的数据点最常描述住院治疗成本，且来自高收入国家。最佳拟合模型使用人均医疗支出来预测治疗成本，并包含国家层面随机效应。估算成本随人均医疗支出增加而增加，住院治疗高于非住院治疗，成人最高，儿童最低。 结论 本研究通过综合现有全球证据，提供了不同年龄组和治疗场所的流感相关医疗成本的新估算。通过外推到没有数据的地区，我们的估算可为全球流感干预措施的未来经济评估研究提供依据。

papers.title: Data-efficient machine learning for the detection of duodenal neoplasia: a multi-centre study
papers.translated_title: 数据高效机器学习用于十二指肠肿瘤检测：一项多中心研究
papers.author: Di Lisio, F.
papers.summary: Background: Machine Learning (ML) has shown promise in histopathological diagnosis, but rare tumours, like duodenal epithelial neoplasms, are challenging because large, labelled datasets are difficult to assemble. We propose a data-efficient ML pipeline for detecting duodenal epithelial neoplasia in whole-slide images. Methods: We assembled a five-hospital dataset of haematoxylin and eosin-stained duodenal biopsy whole slide images (WSIs) at 10x magnification, comprising 8,027 normal and 401 neoplastic biopsies, including adenomas, carcinomas and neuroendocrine tumours. WSIs were divided into patches and encoded using the Hibou-B foundation model. We compared global standardisation with unsupervised site-specific standardisation of patch embeddings. Our pipeline combined principal component analysis, a Gaussian mixture model and a Random Forest classifier. We assessed generalisability using leave-one-hospital-out cross-validation across four hospitals and on an independent test set from a fifth hospital. Results: In leave-one-hospital-out cross-validation, the pipeline achieved a mean accuracy of 90%, sensitivity of 96%, specificity of 83% and an AUC of 0.96. On the external test hospital, it achieved 94% accuracy, 93% sensitivity, 95% specificity, and AUC of 0.97. Site-specific standardisation improved mean cross-validation accuracy by 20 percentage points compared with global standardisation, while the Gaussian mixture pipeline improved accuracy by 12 percentage points compared with mean pooling of patch embeddings. Conclusions: We present a data-efficient ML approach for detecting duodenal epithelial neoplasia from WSIs. Strong performance was maintained across hospitals and on an independent external test cohort despite the limited number of neoplastic training cases, supporting the feasibility of foundation-model-based approaches for rare histopathological diagnoses.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：机器学习（ML）在组织病理学诊断中已展现出前景，但罕见肿瘤，如十二指肠上皮肿瘤，由于难以构建大型标注数据集而具有挑战性。我们提出了一种数据高效的ML流程，用于在全切片图像中检测十二指肠上皮肿瘤。方法：我们构建了一个来自五家医院的苏木精-伊红染色十二指肠活检全切片图像（WSIs）数据集，放大倍数为10倍，包含8，027例正常活检和401例肿瘤性活检，包括腺瘤、癌和神经内分泌肿瘤。WSIs被划分为图像块，并使用Hibou-B基础模型进行编码。我们比较了图像块嵌入的全局标准化与无监督位点特异性标准化。我们的流程结合了主成分分析、高斯混合模型和随机森林分类器。我们通过在四家医院进行留一医院交叉验证，并在来自第五家医院的独立测试集上进行评估，以评估泛化能力。结果：在留一医院交叉验证中，该流程实现了平均准确率90%、灵敏度96%、特异度83%和AUC 0.96。在外部测试医院上，它实现了94%的准确率、93%的灵敏度、95%的特异度和AUC 0.97。与全局标准化相比，位点特异性标准化将平均交叉验证准确率提高了20个百分点，而高斯混合流程与图像块嵌入的平均池化相比将准确率提高了12个百分点。结论：我们提出了一种数据高效的ML方法，用于从WSIs中检测十二指肠上皮肿瘤。尽管肿瘤性训练病例数量有限，但在各医院以及独立外部测试队列中均保持了强劲的性能，支持基于基础模型的方法用于罕见组织病理学诊断的可行性。

papers.title: Exposure Records Preserved by Two Users of Japan's COVID-19 Contact-Confirming Application During the Seventh Wave: A Descriptive Study
papers.translated_title: 日本第七波疫情期间两名COVID-19接触确认应用程序用户保留的暴露记录：一项描述性研究
papers.author: Nakagawa, S.
papers.summary: Introduction: Japan's COVID-19 Contact-Confirming Application (COCOA) stopped functioning in November 2022, and the records held on users' devices were lost with it. We describe the exposure records preserved by two users during the seventh wave of COVID-19 in Japan and the changes around the revision of full mandatory case reporting on September 26, 2022. Methods: We analyzed exposure windows (date, duration, and minimum attenuation) contained in files exported from the app. Observer 1 worked at a hospital in Tokyo and commuted almost exclusively by private car; Observer 2 lived in Kyoto Prefecture and spent most of the time at home. Seven-day rolling sums of exposure windows were compared descriptively with daily new case counts in each prefecture. Results: During the common pre-revision period (April 3 to September 25, 2022; 176 days), Observer 1 recorded 358 exposure windows and Observer 2 recorded 261. The rolling sums rose in July and fell in September, as did new case counts (r-squared = 0.807 and 0.397), but week-on-week changes corresponded weakly (r-squared = 0.183 and 0.002). Of the windows in this period, 97.2% and 93.1% had a minimum attenuation of 65 dB or more, the bucket given the lowest weight in the notification decision. After the revision, Observer 1 recorded three windows in 27 days (45 in the preceding 27 days), and Observer 2 recorded none in 23 days (25 in the preceding 27 days). Conclusions: The exposure-window records of two users rose and fell with the seventh wave, although the correspondence of week-to-week changes was limited. Recorded windows decreased after the revision, but the effects of the policy change, the supply of diagnosis keys, app usage, and operating-system updates cannot be separated. This descriptive report does not evaluate the preventive effectiveness of COCOA. It shows that indicator definitions, retrieval dates, and the history of software and policy changes are essential when records left on users' devices are analyzed after the fact.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：日本的COVID-19接触确认应用（COCOA）于2022年11月停止运行，随之丢失了用户设备上保存的记录。我们描述了两位用户在日本第七波COVID-19期间保存的暴露记录，以及2022年9月26日全面强制病例报告修订前后的变化。方法：我们分析了从该应用导出文件中包含的暴露窗口（日期、时长和最低衰减值）。观察者1在东京一家医院工作，几乎完全通过私家车通勤；观察者2居住在京都府，大部分时间待在家中。我们将暴露窗口的7天滚动总和与各都道府县的每日新增病例数进行了描述性比较。结果：在共同的修订前时期（2022年4月3日至9月25日；176天），观察者1记录了358个暴露窗口，观察者2记录了261个。滚动总和在7月上升，9月下降，新增病例数也是如此（r平方=0.807和0.397），但周环比变化的对应关系较弱（r平方=0.183和0.002）。在这一时期的窗口中，分别有97.2%和93.1%的最低衰减值为65 dB或以上，这是通知决策中权重最低的区间。修订后，观察者1在27天内记录了3个窗口（此前27天为45个），观察者2在23天内未记录任何窗口（此前27天为25个）。结论：两位用户的暴露窗口记录随第七波疫情上升和下降，尽管周环比变化的对应关系有限。修订后记录的窗口减少，但政策变化、诊断密钥供应、应用使用和操作系统更新的影响无法分离。这份描述性报告并未评估COCOA的预防效果。它表明，在事后分析用户设备上留下的记录时，指标定义、检索日期以及软件和政策变化的历史至关重要。

papers.title: A Stratified Worm Burden Framework for Endemic Equilibria, Demography, and Mass Drug Administration: Linking Classical Macroparasite Models to Transmission Dynamics
papers.translated_title: 分层虫负荷框架：地方性平衡、人口学与大规模给药——连接经典宏观寄生虫模型与传播动力学
papers.author: Gurarie, D.
papers.summary: Background. Classical macroparasite models commonly represent worm burden heterogeneity through prescribed Poisson or negative-binomial (NB) distributions, while transmission dynamics are formulated in terms of aggregate quantities such as mean worm burden and prevalence. We revisit these assumptions using a stratified worm burden (SWB) framework that explicitly tracks the distribution of parasite burdens across heterogeneous host classes and allows demographic turnover, transmission, and interventions to be analyzed within a unified model. Methods. We derive equilibrium distributions of the SWB system under homogeneous and heterogeneous infection processes and compare them with the classical Poisson and NB distributions used in macroparasite epidemiology and control policymaking. The framework is then extended to include host demography, coupled human-snail transmission dynamics, and periodic mass drug administration (MDA). Corresponding SWB and NB-type MacDonald models are calibrated to comparable endemic prevalence and mean worm burden, allowing direct comparison of potential transmission breakpoints and intervention outcomes. Results. In the absence of demographic turnover, the SWB framework naturally generates Poisson and NB equilibrium distributions as limiting cases of homogeneous and heterogeneous infection processes. Incorporating demographic recruitment and mortality alters these benchmark distributions, producing endemic burden structures that differ systematically from their classical counterparts. Analysis of coupled human-snail systems reveals that transmission breakpoints and bistable equilibria occur only within a relatively restricted region of SWB parameter space. In contrast, comparable NB-MacDonald formulations exhibit breakpoint behavior over substantially broader parameter ranges with the net effect of overestimating the likelihood of interruption of transmission. Although calibrated models can reproduce near identical endemic prevalence and mean worm burden, they often generate markedly different responses to MDA, including differences in rebound dynamics, persistence, and elimination thresholds. Conclusions. The SWB framework links classical statistical descriptions of worm aggregation to mechanistic burden-resolved population dynamics, clarifying how endemic distributions emerge and how they are modified by demography and control interventions. Our results suggest that transmission breakpoints are not a universal feature of helminth systems but depend strongly on model structure, and that predictions of elimination and post-treatment recovery may be considerably more model-dependent than implied by prevalence-based calibration alone. The SWB approach therefore provides a flexible alternative framework for evaluating parasite transmission dynamics and predicting the outcomes of control strategies.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。经典大型寄生虫模型通常通过预设的泊松分布或负二项分布来表示蠕虫负荷的异质性，而传播动力学则以平均蠕虫负荷和患病率等聚合量来表述。我们使用分层蠕虫负荷框架重新审视这些假设，该框架明确追踪异质性宿主类别间寄生虫负荷的分布，并允许在统一模型中分析人口更替、传播和干预。方法。我们推导了同质和异质感染过程下分层蠕虫负荷系统的平衡分布，并将其与大型寄生虫流行病学和控制政策制定中使用的经典泊松分布和负二项分布进行比较。随后将该框架扩展至包含宿主人口统计学、人-螺耦合传播动力学以及周期性大规模药物给药。相应的分层蠕虫负荷模型和负二项型MacDonald模型被校准至可比的地方性患病率和平均蠕虫负荷，从而可以直接比较潜在的传播阈值和干预结果。结果。在不存在人口更替的情况下，分层蠕虫负荷框架自然生成泊松分布和负二项分布作为同质和异质感染过程的极限情形。引入人口补充和死亡后，这些基准分布发生改变，产生与经典对应物系统性不同的地方性负荷结构。对耦合人-螺系统的分析表明，传播阈值和双稳态平衡仅出现在分层蠕虫负荷参数空间中相对有限的区域内。相比之下，可比的负二项-MacDonald公式在更广泛的参数范围内表现出阈值行为，其净效应是高估了传播中断的可能性。尽管校准后的模型可以重现几乎相同的地方性患病率和平均蠕虫负荷，但它们对大规模药物给药的反应往往显著不同，包括反弹动力学、持续性和消除阈值方面的差异。结论。分层蠕虫负荷框架将蠕虫聚集的经典统计描述与机制性的负荷分辨种群动力学联系起来，阐明了地方性分布如何出现以及它们如何被人口统计学和控制干预所改变。我们的结果表明，传播阈值并非蠕虫系统的普遍特征，而是强烈依赖于模型结构，并且对消除和治疗后恢复的预测可能比仅基于患病率校准所暗示的更加依赖于模型。因此，分层蠕虫负荷方法为评估寄生虫传播动力学和预测控制策略结果提供了一个灵活的替代框架。

papers.title: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A(H7N7) Virus, Taiwan, 2026
papers.translated_title: 2026年台湾人感染甲型H7N7禽流感病毒
papers.author: Li, Y.-T.
papers.summary: Low pathogenic avian influenza A(H7N7) virus detected in a poultry worker in Taiwan, 2026 was related to viruses circulating in Asian wild birds and possessed PB2 E627K, a mammalian adaptation marker. Enhanced surveillance for H7 viruses in poultry and rapid characterization of human cases are essential to assess pandemic potential.
papers.translated_summary: 2026年在台湾一名家禽工人中检测到低致病性甲型H7N7禽流感病毒，该病毒与亚洲野鸟中流行的病毒相关，并携带PB2 E627K这一哺乳动物适应标志。加强对家禽中H7病毒的监测以及对人类病例的快速表征，对于评估大流行潜力至关重要。

papers.title: Microbial traits have minimal power for predicting death from bloodstream infection
papers.translated_title: 微生物特征对预测血流感染致死几乎没有预测能力
papers.author: Gilliland, R.
papers.summary: Bloodstream infection (BSI) is a life-threatening condition where the risk of dying is affected by both patient- and pathogen-related factors. Certain microbial traits (e.g., virulence genes) are thought to affect survival rates from BSIs, but the magnitude of their impact on human mortality remains unclear. To address this, we analyzed the microbial genomes, quantitative proteomes, and electronic medical records (EMRs) from 35,746 BSIs from Calgary, Canada (2006-2022). We show that EMR-based machine learning models accurately predict 30-day mortality (AUC=0.83), but surprisingly, integrating >70,000 microbial genes/proteins does not improve this performance. We demonstrate that microbial factors co-segregate with specific patient cohorts and are therefore not independent predictors of risk. We conclude that microbial virulence factors have minimal impact on mortality rates from BSIs.
papers.translated_summary: 血流感染（BSI）是一种危及生命的状况，其死亡风险受患者和病原体相关因素的双重影响。某些微生物特征（如毒力基因）被认为会影响BSI的存活率，但其对人类死亡率的实际影响程度仍不明确。为解决这一问题，我们分析了来自加拿大卡尔加里（2006-2022年）的35,746例BSI的微生物基因组、定量蛋白质组和电子病历（EMR）。我们发现，基于EMR的机器学习模型能准确预测30天死亡率（AUC=0.83），但令人惊讶的是，整合超过70,000个微生物基因/蛋白质并未提升这一预测性能。我们证明微生物因素与特定患者群体共分离，因此并非独立的风险预测因子。我们得出结论：微生物毒力因子对BSI死亡率的影响极小。

papers.title: SCORES (Selection of Clinical Observations for Risk Evaluation Scores): Impact of Heart Rate Selection on Simplified Geneva Score Performance in Suspected Pulmonary Embolism
papers.translated_title: SCORES（临床观察指标选择用于风险评估评分）：心率选择对疑似肺栓塞中简化日内瓦评分性能的影响
papers.author: Cole, C.
papers.summary: Abstract Background The Simplified Geneva Score (SGS) incorporates two heart-rate thresholds. Multiple heart-rate measurements are commonly recorded during emergency department (ED) assessment. While the original SGS specifies use of mean heart rate, real-world implementation is unlikely to reflect this, and the effect of alternative heart-rate selection methods on score performance is unknown. Methods SCORES was a retrospective within-subject study of consecutive ED patients at a single urban hospital undergoing computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) for suspected pulmonary embolism (PE). Four SGS variants were calculated using the first, highest, mean, and lowest recorded pre-CTPA heart rate. Outcomes included score output, risk classification, diagnostic performance, reclassification flow, and downstream imaging utilisation. Precision estimates and comparisons were derived using empirical resampling techniques. Results 590 episodes were reviewed with 581 included for analysis. PE was confirmed in 50 cases (8.6%). Mean SGS differed significantly across all heart-rate implementations (p<0.0001). The proportion classified as high risk varied from 15% using the lowest heart rate to 40% using the highest heart rate. Reclassification across the SGS threshold was common, with 25% of episodes changing risk category unidirectionally between lowest and highest heart rate implementations. SGS(lowest HR) compared with SGS(mean HR) and SGS(highest HR) demonstrated higher specificity (87.6% vs 73.4% vs 62.1%), improved AUROC (0.744 vs 0.704 vs 0.659), and reduced downstream CTPA utilisation (818 vs 876 vs 920 scans per 100 PEs diagnosed), with no additional pulmonary emboli missed within the complete diagnostic pathway. Conclusions Heart-rate selection materially influences SGS output, risk classification, diagnostic performance, and imaging utilisation. In this retrospective cohort, use of the lowest recorded heart rate produced the most favourable overall balance of discrimination and diagnostic efficiency, supporting prospective validation.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景 简化日内瓦评分（SGS）包含两个心率阈值。急诊科（ED）评估期间通常会记录多次心率测量值。虽然原始SGS规定使用平均心率，但实际应用不太可能反映这一点，而替代性心率选择方法对评分性能的影响尚不清楚。 方法 SCORES是一项回顾性受试者内研究，纳入某城市单一医院连续就诊的急诊科患者，这些患者因疑似肺栓塞（PE）接受计算机断层肺血管造影（CTPA）。使用CTPA前记录的首个、最高、平均和最低心率计算四种SGS变体。结局包括评分输出、风险分类、诊断性能、重分类流程和下游影像利用。精确度估计和比较采用经验重采样技术得出。 结果 共审查590次发作，581次纳入分析。50例确诊PE（8.6%）。不同心率实施方式之间的平均SGS存在显著差异（p<0.0001）。被归类为高风险的比例从使用最低心率的15%到使用最高心率的40%不等。跨SGS阈值的重分类很常见，25%的发作在最低和最高心率实施方式之间单向改变风险类别。与SGS（平均心率）和SGS（最高心率）相比，SGS（最低心率）表现出更高的特异性（87.6% vs 73.4% vs 62.1%）、改善的AUROC（0.744 vs 0.704 vs 0.659），并减少了下游CTPA利用（每诊断100例PE分别为818 vs 876 vs 920次扫描），且在完整诊断路径中未额外漏诊肺栓塞。 结论 心率选择对SGS输出、风险分类、诊断性能和影像利用产生实质性影响。在该回顾性队列中，使用记录的最低心率在区分度和诊断效率之间产生了最有利的总体平衡，支持进行前瞻性验证。

papers.title: Carbonaceous Components Underlying Wildfire Smoke PM2.5-Associated Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias in Older US Adults
papers.translated_title: 美国老年人中与野火烟雾PM2.5相关的阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症背后的碳质组分
papers.author: Jin, Z.
papers.summary: Wildfire smoke exposure is increasing across the U.S., but the long-term neurological effects of smoke-specific fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and its carbonaceous components remain uncertain. Using Medicare data from 2002 through 2019, we examined incident Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD) among 39,678,630 fee-for-service Medicare beneficiaries followed from 2005 through 2019. We identified 3,501,414 incident AD cases over 258.5 million person-years and 8,377,416 incident ADRD cases over 248.6 million person-years. We linked the cohort with annual, high-resolution estimates of smoke and non-smoke PM2.5 mass and carbonaceous components (elemental and organic carbon) and fitted stratified Cox proportional hazards models. Per 1 g/m3 increase, smoke PM2.5 was associated with incident AD (hazard ratio [HR], 1.015, 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.005-1.026) and ADRD (1.029 [1.024-1.035]). Smoke carbonaceous fraction was also associated with AD (1.063 [1.042-1.085]) and ADRD (1.090 [1.077-1.103]). Within the ADRD endpoint, smoke-related associations exceeded their corresponding non-smoke associations on a per-unit-mass basis. Per interquartile range, associations were smaller for smoke PM2.5 (AD, 1.005 [1.002-1.008]; ADRD, 1.009 [1.008-1.011]) than for non-smoke PM2.5 (AD, 1.086 [1.079-1.094]; ADRD, 1.048 [1.043-1.053]). Associations varied across geographic, racial, socioeconomic, and clinical subgroups. Long-term wildfire smoke exposure, particularly its carbonaceous fraction, was associated with higher incidence of AD and ADRD among older U.S. adults. The associations correspond to 2,284 and 11,142 incident cases per year of AD and ADRD attributable to smoke PM2.5 among older Medicare beneficiaries, with the carbonaceous fraction accounting for most of this burden. These findings support the use of source-resolved and composition-specific smoke metrics in dementia research and wildfire-smoke health-impact assessments.
papers.translated_summary: 野火烟雾暴露在美国日益增加，但烟雾特异性细颗粒物（PM2.5）及其碳质组分对神经系统的长期影响仍不确定。我们利用2002年至2019年的Medicare数据，研究了39,678,630名按服务收费的Medicare受益人中新发的阿尔茨海默病（AD）以及阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆（ADRD），随访时间为2005年至2019年。我们在258.5百万人年中识别出3,501,414例新发AD病例，在248.6百万人年中识别出8,377,416例新发ADRD病例。我们将该队列与烟雾和非烟雾PM2.5质量及碳质组分（元素碳和有机碳）的年度高分辨率估计值相链接，并拟合分层Cox比例风险模型。每增加1 g/m3，烟雾PM2.5与新发AD相关（风险比[HR]，1.015，95%置信区间[CI]，1.005-1.026）和ADRD相关（1.029 [1.024-1.035]）。烟雾碳质组分也与AD相关（1.063 [1.042-1.085]）和ADRD相关（1.090 [1.077-1.103]）。在ADRD终点内，按单位质量计算，烟雾相关关联超过相应的非烟雾关联。按四分位距计算，烟雾PM2.5的关联较小（AD，1.005 [1.002-1.008]；ADRD，1.009 [1.008-1.011]），而非烟雾PM2.5的关联较大（AD，1.086 [1.079-1.094]；ADRD，1.048 [1.043-1.053]）。这些关联在地理、种族、社会经济和临床亚组之间存在差异。长期野火烟雾暴露，尤其是其碳质组分，与美国老年人AD和ADRD发病率升高相关。这些关联对应于老年Medicare受益人中每年可归因于烟雾PM2.5的2,284例AD和11,142例ADRD新发病例，其中碳质组分占该负担的大部分。这些发现支持在痴呆研究和野火烟雾健康影响评估中使用源解析和组分特异性的烟雾指标。
